description.value: Northern Spice Pizza & Donair is a pizza and donair restaurant located in Northern BC, serving the community around the 50th Avenue North corridor. For touring cyclists making their way through this remote stretch of the province, it represents one of the few sit-down dining options in the area. The donair offering reflects the Western Canadian tradition of this Middle Eastern-inspired street food staple.
